reuse.why: Linking reuses assertBankAccountNotLinked, link.findOrCreateBank and linkBankSyncAccount, but the download path copies downloadAkahuTransactions instead of factoring a shared provider download helper.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions is a line-for-line copy of downloadAkahuTransactions (post, error mapping, response shaping), differing only in the server URL and log string.

placement.why: Server URL in server-config, link handler in accounts/app.ts, download in accounts/sync.ts and the account type in types/models, exactly where the other providers live.

scope.why: Focused on the provider; the two small client edits are type-forced by the SYNC_PROVIDERS union (Record/satisfies), not unrelated changes.

maintainability.why: Easy to follow and consistent with siblings, but adds a third verbatim copy of the same download function that a maintainer must keep in sync.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Linking goes through linkBankSyncAccount/assertBankAccountNotLinked; no existing download abstraction is bypassed (none exists, the copy is the problem).

disguised_duplication.where: downloadFintegraTransactions in sync.ts is an undisguised verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions.
